Impacted Systems: Windows versions from Windows 7 and Windows Server 2008 to Windows 11 and Windows Server 2022
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated attacker calling LSARPC interface method to coerce domain controller authentication
MITM attacks intercepting traffic between victim and domain controller
Indicators of Compromise: Related to PetitPotam NTLM relay attack
Exploited in the wild by LockFile ransomware operators
